alert.$description: Inline status banner — contextual messaging inside a flow (the betslip footer's 'cannot include suspended outcome', 'odds have changed', 'balance too low', 'log in to place your bet'). New to the system: nothing else does colored contextual messaging. One style: a 12% colored tint fill (bg.*) + a colored 1px border (outline.*) + a status icon, a single message line in white — no title. Four roles map to the semantic status colours (warning/negative/positive) plus accent for info, each optionally with a close ×. The betslip itself uses `warning` for nearly everything (even 'balance too low' shows the gold triangle in the reference), but Alert carries all four so it's reusable beyond the slip. The solid full-bleed app-wide bar lives in Toast (`toast --global`) — it is a docked notification, not an in-flow banner.

gap.$description: 8px between the icon, body and close.

message.$description: 14px regular — the banner message. Alerts are a single message line (no title) — just a status colour, an icon and text.

text.$description: Message colour — white on the dark tint.

role.$description: Outline-style colours per status: a 12% colored tint fill (bg.*), a colored border (outline.*), a colored status icon (icon.*). Message text stays text.default (white) on all four.
